purpose: Prospectively test whether a parameter-free single-slot role-consensus intervention can add FRC evidence utility without repeating v56's over-compression, while preserving the document-contrastive abstention mechanism on a previously unused conversational answer/no-answer source.

prior_result_boundary.allowed_aggregate_motivation_only: v56 established that the document gate can reject no-answer cases but the role-closure candidate over-compressed answer-bearing evidence.

theoretical_mechanism.name: anchor_safe_single_slot_consensus_frc_v57
theoretical_mechanism.base: Shared-gate cross-encoder Top-5 under the same token budget, including its frozen skip-over-budget behavior.
theoretical_mechanism.anchor_floor: When the baseline selects five units, preserve its first four budget-feasible selections exactly; otherwise reproduce the baseline.
theoretical_mechanism.eligible_contender: A candidate at anchor rank 6 through 12 that appears in the Top-3 of at least two non-anchor atomic roles.
theoretical_mechanism.single_slot_rule: If the baseline selected five units and an eligible contender fits beside the preserved first four, replace only the fifth baseline selection with the contender having the largest supporting-role count, then the smallest summed supporting-role rank, then the best anchor rank, then opaque id. Otherwise reproduce the baseline exactly.
theoretical_mechanism.budget_rule: Reuse the frozen cross-encoder Top-5 budget selection first, then permit the one-for-one fifth-slot replacement only when the contender keeps total cost within the same budget.
theoretical_mechanism.rationale: The formula can expose one independently supported functional-role candidate while bounding baseline displacement to 20 percent and reverting exactly when role concurrence is absent.

source.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 as stated on the official QuAC homepage
source.known_public_structure: SQuAD-like data -> section -> paragraphs/dialogues -> qas, with question, orig_answer, answers, followup and yesno fields; CANNOTANSWER denotes no answer.
source.published_scale: 98,407 QA pairs in 13,594 dialogs; train and validation have no overlapping sections; approximately 20.2 percent are unanswerable according to the authors' datasheet.

access_order: Freeze this protocol and the source-independent selector implementation and synthetic invariants before downloading either source file.
Download train and validation as opaque bytes, record size and SHA-256, and register the source without parsing JSON content.
Freeze protocol, source, module, runner and test hashes before opening train for outcome-bearing development preparation.
Parse train only, construct the balanced blind cache, and keep validation unopened.
Register the blind-cache hashes and CUDA runtime before query generation or neural scoring.
Complete every score row before joining answer state or gold evidence intervals.
Run the registered development gates exactly once. Parse validation exactly once only if every development gate passes; otherwise publish a closure and stop.
Never reuse revealed development cases for formula, prompt, cutoff, budget, decoy, threshold or method selection.

task_construction.case: Each QuAC QA turn with a non-empty question and valid original-answer schema.
task_construction.answer_bearing: orig_answer text is not CANNOTANSWER and its exact character interval lies in the dialogue context.
task_construction.gold_evidence: All deterministic context units whose character intervals overlap the original teacher answer interval; no official answer-generation score is claimed.
task_construction.anchor_query: Current question plus at most two preceding question/original-answer pairs from the same dialogue, in chronological order.
task_construction.forbidden_to_query_or_scorer: Current answer text or offset, answer state, future turns, followup/yesno labels, raw source ids, page title and section title.
task_construction.candidate_units: Deterministic sentence spans, with overlong spans split into offset-preserving clauses/windows; trailing CANNOTANSWER sentinel is excluded.
task_construction.schema_exclusion: Missing or malformed context, ids, questions, answer text/offset, invalid answer interval or empty candidate set; rate above 0.01 fails development.

blind_retrieval_and_models.own_retrieval_pool: BM25 Top-48 union BGE dense Top-48, at most 96 candidate units.
blind_retrieval_and_models.contrastive_probe_pool: BM25 Top-8 union BGE dense Top-8 per document, at most 16 candidate units.
blind_retrieval_and_models.decoys: Seven other dialogue documents from the same context-length quartile, hash ordered with FRC-QUAC-V57-DECOY; any fallback fails development.
blind_retrieval_and_models.gate: The associated dialogue document must rank first among eight by maximum raw anchor reranker logit, giving p=1/8 under the registered exchangeability construction.

frozen_queries.direct_answer: Find the passage that directly answers the current question in this conversation: {conversation_query}
frozen_queries.context_bridge: Find antecedents, people, events, or earlier context needed to resolve the current question: {conversation_query}
frozen_queries.contrast_or_limit: Find negations, contrasts, qualifications, dates, or limitations relevant to the current question: {conversation_query}

methods.ungated_controls: Frozen v41/v43/v49 FRC controls and the five frozen non-FRC controls.

evaluation.answer_metric: Exact deterministic evidence-unit set F1 against the original teacher answer interval.

scope_limits: English Wikipedia conversational evidence-unit selection under an artificial balanced mechanism sample; not QuAC official answer extraction, hidden-test submission, open-corpus retrieval, SetR reproduction, flood-domain validation or rollout authorization.
